manifest.name: Pi - TypeScript Dependency Navigator
manifest.description: Maps TypeScript files by package, imports, exports, dependents, public API surface, coupling risk, and code-intent purpose to help agents navigate feature work and assess blast radius.

analyzers.name: TypeScript Dependency Map
analyzers.description: Maps TypeScript file dependencies, public API shape, coupling risk, code-intent purpose, and emitted-event metadata with deterministic and AI-reviewed evidence.

fields.name: file_path
fields.description: The full path to the file being analyzed.

fields.name: file_name
fields.description: The name of the file including its extension.

fields.name: file_extension
fields.description: The file extension without the leading dot, or an empty string if none.

fields.name: chat_id
fields.description: The unique identifier for the file in the current chat context.

fields.name: package_name
fields.description: The owning workspace package name, or an empty string if the file is outside a package.

fields.name: package_dir
fields.description: Repository-relative owning package directory, or an empty string if no package owns the file.

fields.name: file_kind
fields.description: The file category - one of `source`, `test`, `config`, `script`, `generated`, or `fixture`.

fields.name: exports
fields.description: Symbols exported by this file.

fields.name: reexports
fields.description: Symbols or module exports re-exported by this file.

fields.name: imports_symbols
fields.description: Imported symbol names referenced by this file.

fields.name: imports_from
fields.description: Repository-relative workspace file paths this file imports from or re-exports from.

fields.name: exports_to
fields.description: Repository-relative workspace file paths that import from or re-export from this file.

fields.name: external_imports
fields.description: External module specifiers imported or re-exported by this file.

fields.name: emits_events
fields.description: Final queryable emitted event type names. Uses review-confirmed events when reviewed; empty when review rejects emission; otherwise uses deterministic static candidates.

fields.name: emits_events_static
fields.description: Event type names emitted by this file according to deterministic TypeScript AST extraction.

fields.name: emits_events_static_evidence
fields.description: Deterministic source-pattern evidence strings supporting `emits_events_static`.

fields.name: emits_events_review
fields.description: Event type names confirmed by the `typescript-event-emission-review` analyzer.

fields.name: event_emission_apis_review
fields.description: Emission API names identified by the review analyzer.

fields.name: event_evidence_review
fields.description: Evidence strings from the review analyzer supporting confirmed emitted events.

fields.name: emission_review_status
fields.description: One of `confirmed`, `rejected`, or `not_reviewed`.

fields.name: emission_review_rejected_reason
fields.description: Review rejection reason when no emitted events are confirmed, or an empty string.

fields.name: emission_review_confidence
fields.description: Confidence value from the review analyzer, or an empty string.

fields.name: emits_events_static_not_review
fields.description: Emitted event names found by deterministic extraction but not confirmed by the review analyzer. Empty when no review exists.

fields.name: emits_events_review_not_static
fields.description: Emitted event names confirmed by review but missed by deterministic extraction. Empty when no review exists.

fields.name: event_extraction_sources
fields.description: Sources that contributed emitted-event metadata, such as `static` or `review`.

fields.name: has_public_api
fields.description: True if this file exports a public API surface.

fields.name: is_entry_point
fields.description: True if no workspace files depend on this file.

fields.name: is_leaf
fields.description: True if this file imports no workspace files.

fields.name: dependents_count
fields.description: Number of workspace files that depend on this file.

fields.name: runtime_dependents_count
fields.description: Number of non-test workspace files that depend on this file.

fields.name: test_dependents_count
fields.description: Number of test workspace files that depend on this file.

fields.name: dependencies_count
fields.description: Number of workspace files this file depends on.

fields.name: coupling_risk
fields.description: Derived coupling risk level - `low`, `medium`, or `high`.

fields.name: purpose
fields.description: Inherited from the `code-intent` brain; empty string when unavailable.
